webinar.title: The Tax Trap
webinar.subtitle: A free class for engineers and long-time employees with $1 million or more in 401(k)s and IRAs
promises: Why "I'll be in a lower bracket when I retire" can backfire, and the 2026 numbers that show it
How RMDs, Social Security, Medicare surcharges, and RSUs stack up on the same tax return
The planning window before your RMDs begin, and the questions to bring to your advisor and CPA before it closes
who: Most of your savings is in a 401(k) or IRA
You're 58 to 68 and retiring within five years, or just retired
You have RSUs, a side business, or a rental
No one has ever shown you a multi-year tax projection
webinar.credibility: Retirement income, tax and estate planner in Fort Collins, Colorado · RICP®
webinar.question: What's your biggest tax question about retirement?
webinar.note: Educational class. Includes an invitation to meet one-on-one. Insurance and investment products may be discussed.

what_happens: We'll talk about what matters most to the two of you
We'll walk your Paycheck, Assets, Taxes and Heirs, starting with your biggest gap
You'll leave with your one-page PATH Map, whether or not we ever work together
bring: Last year's tax return (our tax team will run a CPA What-If review)
Recent statements for your retirement and investment accounts
Your Social Security estimates (ssa.gov/myaccount), if you have them
Your will, trust and powers of attorney, if you have them
